    Card Q&A

    • Q7217

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What kind of card does "a card with X in its text" refer to?
      It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
      For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

    • Q7218

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can this card's inherited effect be activated even when I have 0 cards in my security stack?
      Yes.

    • Q7219

      Sep. 18, 2026

      A card with this card in its digivolution cards digivolved with this card's inherited effect.
      At this time, does the digivolved Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect activate?
      No, it does not activate at this time.
      That card's [When Digivolving] effect activates after all of this card's inherited effects are resolved.

    • Q7220

      Sep. 18, 2026

      A card with this card in its digivolution cards digivolved with this card's inherited effect and trashed a card in my security stack.
      At this time, does the digivolved Digimon's "when a card is removed from the security stack" effect trigger?
      Yes, it triggers.

    Card Q&A

    • Q7223

      Sep. 18, 2026

      After using this card's [When Moving] [On Play] effect to trash a card in my hand, can I choose to not return a card from my trash to the hand?
      Yes, you can.

    • Q7224

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What does an "add X000 to the maximum your DP-based deletion effects can delete" effect do?
      It increases the maximum value described in "delete Digimon with DP X000 or less" effects.
      For example, while "[Your Turn] Add 1000 to the maximum DP you can choose with DP-based deletion effects" is active, "[When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less" will allow you to delete an opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less.

    • Q7225

      Sep. 18, 2026

      While an "add X000 to the maximum your DP-based deletion effects can delete" effect is active, can the maximum be increased for an effect such as "delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with DP less than or equal to this Digimon's DP" that references a Digimon's DP for deletion?
      No, it can't be increased.
      You can't increase the maximum of a DP-based deletion effect that doesn't show a numerical value.

    • Q7231

      Sep. 18, 2026

      My opponent has a Digimon with 4000 DP or less.
      Can I use this card's [When Moving] [When Digivolving] effect and fulfill the "if this effect didn't delete" portion by not selecting a card to delete?

      It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
      For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

    • Q7247

      Sep. 18, 2026

      When this card would leave the battle area other than by my effects, I try using its [All Turns] effect to delete another Digimon but another effect prevents it.

    • Q7255

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What kind of card does "a card with X in its text" refer to?
      It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
      For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

    • Q7256

      Sep. 18, 2026

      When a Digimon with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in its text is played, this card's [Your Turn] effect and that Digimon's [On Play] effect trigger simultaneously.
      This card's [Your Turn] effect is activated first to digivolve this card.
      At this time, in what order do I activate the digivolved card's [When Digivolving] effect and the played card's [On Play] effect?
      The [When Digivolving] effect is activated first.
      When your Digimon was played, the [On Play] effect and the [Your Turn] effect triggered simultaneously.
      Activating this card's [Your Turn] effect to digivolve the Digimon caused its [When Digivolving] effect to newly trigger, so it is activated first according to the derived triggering rule.

    Card Q&A

    • Q7261

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What kind of card does "a card with X in its text" refer to?
      It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
      For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

    • Q7262

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What kind of card does the text "[AA] or [BB] in its text" refer to?
      It checks if that card has [AA] or [BB] in its text.

    • Q7263

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can I use on [BT20-045 Examon ACE] to DNA digivolve this card in my hand by using its [All Turns] effect to treat it as [Slayerdramon]?
      No, you can't.
      This [All Turns] effect only activates while this card is in the battle area. It isn't treated as [Slayerdramon] in the hand.

    Card Q&A

    • Q7265

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What exactly does a "can't (perform XX on) stacked cards" effect mean?
      This means that the effect prevents processing of "(perform XX on) stacked cards."
      For example, a "can't trash stacked cards" effect prevents trashing the top stacked cards by (which trashes the top stacked cards) or similar effects, and it prevents trashing the bottom stacked cards by "trash a digivolution card" or similar effects.
      However, because the effect only prevents processing "(perform XX on) stacked cards," XX is still permitted to be performed on the Digimon itself, for instance by effects that tell you to "perform XX" on the Digimon.

    • Q7266

      Sep. 18, 2026

      This card has multiple effects that trigger when it's played or when it digivolves. In what order can they be activated?
      The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

    • Q7267

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What does orientation mean?
      It refers to the suspended or unsuspended state of a card.

    • Q7268

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Do this card's Assembly requirements mean that each Lv.5/Lv.4/Lv.3 card must have [Veemon] or [Veedramon] in its name?
      Yes, they must each satisfy the requirements.

    • Q7269

      Sep. 18, 2026

      This Digimon has [EX13-022 AeroVeedramon] as a digivolution card.
      This Digimon is suspended after receiving a DP reduction, and its DP becomes 0. At this time, can I unsuspend it with [EX13-022 AeroVeedramon]'s inherited effect before it is deleted for having 0 DP?
      No.
      Before triggered effects can activate, a rule check occurs during which all Digimon with 0 DP are deleted.

    Card Q&A

    • Q7289

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What kind of card does "a card with X in its text" refer to?
      It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
      For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

    • Q7290

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What kind of card does the text "[AA] or [BB] in its text" refer to?
      It checks if that card has [AA] or [BB] in its text.

    • Q7291

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can I resolve the portion of this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect that follows "After" even if I don't fulfill the "by doing X" condition?
      No, you can't.
      For this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect, if you don't trash the top card of your security stack, you can't resolve the portion following "After."

    • Q7292

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Due to this card's effect, the DP on one of my opponent's Digimon becomes 0.
      At this point in time, is that Digimon with 0 DP immediately deleted?
      No, it is not immediately deleted at this point in time.
      All activated effects are resolved, after which a rule check occurs. At that point in time, all Digimon with 0 DP are deleted simultaneously.

    Card Q&A

    • Q7294

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What does a "change the base name, color and DP of 1 of your opponent’s Digimon to [Sukamon], white and 3000" effect do, exactly?
      This effect changes 1 of your opponent's Digimon into a Digimon whose original name is [Sukamon], its original color is white, and its original DP is 3000.

    • Q7295

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If a card such as [BT15-035 Geremon] has a (Rule) that gives it card information, what happens when this card's effect changes it to a white Digimon with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP?
      The card information gained from the (Rule) will also be changed.
      For example, [BT15-035 Geremon]'s (Rule) gives it an original name of [Geremon/Numemon], but if its original card information is changed by this effect, its original name becomes just [Sukamon].

      Related Cards

    • Q7296

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If a card such as [EX1-005 Tyrannomon] has an effect that gives it card information, what happens when this card's effect changes it to a white Digimon with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP?
      The card information gained from the effect remains as-is.
      For example, if [EX1-005 Tyrannomon]'s original card information is changed, its original color will become white, and it will also be treated as green due to [EX1-005 Tyrannomon]'s effect, making it a 2-color white and green Digimon.

      Related Cards

    • Q7297

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If a card is changed to a white Digimon with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP, then it digivolves or its top card is trashed by or some other effect, what happens to that card's information?
      It remains as a white Digimon with 3000 DP and an original name of [Sukamon]. The gained effect is carried over even if the Digimon digivolves or one or more of its top cards are trashed.

    • Q7298

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What happens if a card is changed to a white card with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP, then its top card is trashed by or some other effect and the top card becomes a Tamer or Digi-Egg card?
      It remains changed to a white card with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP, but any card information that it didn't originally have can't be changed.

      If it becomes a Tamer or Digi-Egg card, or if it becomes a card that didn't originally have DP, then it will remain without DP.

    • Q7299

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Does this card's inherited effect trigger when either my or my opponent's Digimon with [Sukamon] in its name gets deleted?
      Yes, it triggers.

    • Q7300

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can "from your hand or your Digimon's digivolution cards" reference any Digimon's digivolution cards, including my opponent's?
      No.
      It can only reference your Digimon's digivolution cards.

    • Q7301

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can I resolve the portion of the effect following "After" in this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect even if I don't fulfill the "by doing X" condition?
      No, you can't.
      You can only resolve the portion following "After" in this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect if you trash the top card of your security stack or trash the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers.

    • Q7302

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What does "[When Digivolving] effects don't activate" mean, exactly?
      This effect prevents [When Digivolving] effects on cards from activating.
      [When Digivolving] effects can no longer be activated by triggering or by effects such as "activate that card's [When Digivolving] effect."

    • Q7303

      Sep. 18, 2026

      I used a card affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" to attack.
      Can I activate that card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect at such times?
      Yes, you can.
      The effect can activate if it activates upon the [When Attacking] timing.

    • Q7304

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can other effects activate its [When Digivolving] effect?
      No, they can't activate it.

    • Q7305

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can I process just the "by" condition in its [When Digivolving] effect?
      No, you can't.

    • Q7306

      Sep. 18, 2026

      A card affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" digivolves into a card with a [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect.
      Does that count as a use of the effect's [X Per Turn] even if the effect can't be activated at the time when the card digivolves?
      No, it doesn't count.
      The effect can't activate upon the [When Digivolving] timing, therefore it doesn't count as a use of that effect's [X Per Turn].

    • Q7307

      Sep. 18, 2026

      No, you can't.
      The card has no digivolution cards so it has no stacked cards. Therefore, you can't place it in the security stack.

      Due to this card's effect, the DP on one of my opponent's Digimon becomes 0.
      At this point in time, is that Digimon with 0 DP immediately deleted?
      No, it is not immediately deleted at this point in time.
      All activated effects are resolved, after which a rule check occurs. At that point in time, all Digimon with 0 DP are deleted simultaneously.

    • Q7312

      Sep. 18, 2026

      My Digimon with [EX13-004 DemiMeramon] as a digivolution card digivolves into this card, and I activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to trash a card from my security stack and attack with this card.
      At this time, in what order does this card's [All Turns] effect and [EX13-004 DemiMeramon]'s inherited effect activate?
      The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
      However, if [EX13-004 DemiMeramon]'s inherited effect is activated first and this card digivolves, then this card will lose its [All Turns] effect so you will not be able to activate it.

    Card Q&A

    • Q7313

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What kind of card does "a card with X in its text" refer to?
      It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
      For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

    • Q7314

      Sep. 18, 2026

      When performing a security check, if a [Security] effect, a "when this Digimon checks an opponent's security" effect, and a "when a security stack is removed from" effect trigger simultaneously, what order do they activate in?
      The [Security] effect is activated first.
      When a [Security] effect is checked, it is activated immediately without waiting.
      Activate the other triggered effects in order, starting with the turn player's effects.

    • Q7315

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What does this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect do, exactly?
      If activated, first choose if you are going to return 10 specified cards from your trash to the bottom of your deck. If you do, this effect's play cost maximum is increased by 6.

    • Q7316

      The condition for this [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect requires you to return 10 specified cards to the bottom of the deck.

    Card Q&A

    • Q7318

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What does an "instead" effect mean, exactly?
      The processing shown after "instead" in the effect replaces the standard processing.
      For example, if an effect reads "Delete your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less. If you have a Digimon with [Greymon] in its name, instead delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP," and you have a Digimon with [Greymon] in its name, you delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP instead of deleting 1 of their Digimon with 6000 DP or less.

    • Q7319

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What happens for "1 player with the most security cards" if both players have the same number of security cards?
      The player that activated the effect chooses 1 player.

    • Q7320

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can I activate a [Counter] effect and then activate another [Counter] effect?
      No, you can't. Only 1 [Counter] effect can be activated per an attack.

    • Q7321

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Multiple effects trigger when this card digivolves. In what order do they activate?
      The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

      Yes, they must each satisfy the requirements.

      Yes, it battles after its [Security] effect activates.

      Yes, it can.

      Sep. 18, 2026

      When performing a security check, if a [Security] effect, a "when this Digimon checks an opponent's security" effect, and a "when a security stack is removed from" effect trigger simultaneously, what order do they activate in?
      The [Security] effect is activated first.

      Activate the other triggered effects in order, starting with the turn player's effects.

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What does "may battle" mean, exactly?

    • Q7350

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If 2 Digimon including a Digimon that has an "effects don't affect" effect are chosen for a "may battle" effect, can those Digimon battle?
      Yes, they can battle.
      A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect can still be chosen for an effect. In addition, a battle itself is a rule that compares DP, not an effect. Therefore, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen, and then it can battle.
      If it loses the battle, it will be deleted as normal according to the rules.

    • Q7354

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What kind of card does "a card with X in its text" refer to?
      It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
      For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

    • Q7370

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What does the "players can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" effect do, exactly?
      With this effect, each player's memory can no longer be increased by any effects except Tamer effects. This effect affects both players.

    • Q7371

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can I gain memory using an effect on a Tamer that's treated as a Digimon with X000 DP due to an effect while my opponent has "players can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects" activated?
      Yes, you can.
      When an effect is activated on a card that's treated as both a Digimon and a Tamer, the effect is treated as both a Digimon effect and a Tamer effect, therefore you can gain memory.

    Card Q&A

    • Q7373

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What kind of card does "a card with X in its text" refer to?
      It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
      For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

    • Q7374

      Sep. 18, 2026

      When one of my Digimon would leave the battle area by my opponent's effect, two copies of on two of these cards trigger simultaneously.
      I activate the first card's effect, preventing the Digimon from leaving the battle area.
      Afterwards, can I still activate the second card's effect?
      Yes, you can.
      When one of your Digimon would leave the battle area by your opponent's effect, this card's effects trigger simultaneously.
      After activating the first effect and preventing the Digimon from leaving, you can activate the second copy as well.
      Afterward, the [On Play] [On Deletion] effects on both copies of this card trigger simultaneously, adding up to a total of two activations.

    Card Q&A

    • Q7380

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What does "effects don't affect" mean, exactly?
      This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects.
      For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.

    • Q7381

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?
      Yes, it can be chosen.
      For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.

    • Q7382

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?
      Yes, it can.
      It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect.
      However, if an effect such as is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

    • Q7383

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
      As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.

    • Q7384

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If a card with an "effects don't affect" effect gains an effect then later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
      It will be affected by the gained effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

    • Q7385

      Sep. 18, 2026

      A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking].
      Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
      If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

    • Q7386

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What does "also" mean?
      “Also” means that the effect given by that effect has the same duration and targets as that effect's previously resolved portion.
      For example, in the case of “Until the end of the turn, all of your XX Digimon gain AA. If you have a Tamer, they also gain BB,” all of your XX Digimon gain AA until the end of the turn, and if you have a Tamer, all of your XX Digimon also gain BB until the end of the turn as well.

    • Q7387

      Sep. 18, 2026

      I activate this card's [End of Attack] effect and digivolve it into [BT20-056 Alphamon].
      At this time, is the "if during an attack" condition in [BT20-056 Alphamon]'s [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect fulfilled?
      Yes, it is.
      When the end of an attack occurs, it is still during that attack.

    Card Q&A

    • Q7380

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What does "effects don't affect" mean, exactly?
      This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects.
      For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.

    • Q7381

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?
      Yes, it can be chosen.
      For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.

    • Q7382

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?
      Yes, it can.
      It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect.
      However, if an effect such as is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

    • Q7383

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
      As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.

    • Q7384

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If a card with an "effects don't affect" effect gains an effect then later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
      It will be affected by the gained effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

    • Q7385

      Sep. 18, 2026

      A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking].
      Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
      If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

    • Q7386

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What does "also" mean?
      “Also” means that the effect given by that effect has the same duration and targets as that effect's previously resolved portion.
      For example, in the case of “Until the end of the turn, all of your XX Digimon gain AA. If you have a Tamer, they also gain BB,” all of your XX Digimon gain AA until the end of the turn, and if you have a Tamer, all of your XX Digimon also gain BB until the end of the turn as well.

    • Q7387

      Sep. 18, 2026

      I activate this card's [End of Attack] effect and digivolve it into [BT20-056 Alphamon].
      At this time, is the "if during an attack" condition in [BT20-056 Alphamon]'s [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect fulfilled?
      Yes, it is.
      When the end of an attack occurs, it is still during that attack.

      Related Cards

    • Q7388

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What does this card's inherited effect do, exactly?
      This effect triggers and can be activated when a Digimon specified by it leaves the battle area under the specified conditions.
      When activated, all Digimon matching its trigger conditions are prevented from leaving.

    Card Q&A

    • Q7390

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If a text says "XX card with AA or BB," does that mean AA and BB both have to be XX?
      Yes, both have to be XX.
      For example, "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [CS] trait or that is yellow or black" means either "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [CS] trait" or "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card that is yellow or black." In both cases, the card must be level 4 or lower.

    • Q7391

      Sep. 18, 2026

      I am trying to play a card revealed by this card's effect.
      At this time, can I perform Assembly for the card I'm trying to play and place cards being revealed under it?
      No, you can't.
      Cards being revealed by this card's effect have not been placed in the trash yet, so you can't place them under the card you're trying to play while performing Assembly for it.

    • Q7392

      It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
      For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

    • Q7398

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What does "effects don't affect" mean, exactly?
      This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects.
      For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.

    • Q7399

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?
      Yes, it can be chosen.
      For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.

    • Q7400

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?
      Yes, it can.
      It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect.
      However, if an effect such as is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

    • Q7401

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
      As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.

    • Q7402

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If a card with an "effects don't affect" effect gains an effect then later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
      It will be affected by the gained effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

    • Q7403

      Sep. 18, 2026

      A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking].
      Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
      If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.

    • Q7404

      Yes, it will be removed from the stack.

    Card Q&A

    • Q7414

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What kind of card does "a card with X in its text" refer to?
      It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
      For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

    • Q7415

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If a text says "XX card with AA or BB," does that mean AA and BB both have to be XX?
      Yes, both have to be XX.
      For example, "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [CS] trait or that is yellow or black" means either "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [CS] trait" or "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card that is yellow or black." In both cases, the card must be level 4 or lower.

    • Q7416

      Sep. 18, 2026

      I am trying to play a card revealed by this card's effect.
      At this time, can I perform Assembly for the card I'm trying to play and place cards being revealed under it?
      No, you can't.
      Cards being revealed by this card's effect have not been placed in the trash yet, so you can't place them under the card you're trying to play while performing Assembly for it.

    • Q7417

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Multiple effects trigger when this card is deleted. In what order can they be activated?
      The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

      After giving and to a Digimon with this card's second [Your Turn] effect, can I choose not to attack with that Digimon?

    • Q7420

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What kind of card does "a card with X in its text" refer to?
      It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.

    • Q7421

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Does the digivolution requirement that this card digivolve from a Tamer mean the Tamer that becomes a digivolution card is treated as if it is a Digimon when digivolving?
      No. Digivolve from the Tamer as such, and do not treat it as if it is a digivolving Digimon. "When a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger.
      Additionally, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect has activated, you can still digivolve from a Tamer with this digivolve requirement.

    • Q7422

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Do I perform a digivolution bonus draw even if I digivolve from a Tamer?
      Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw.
      A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

    • Q7423

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack this turn?
      No, it can't.
      A card can't attack on the turn it is played, even if it digivolves from a card placed on the field. It can only attack if it was not played that turn.

    • Q7424

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Does a Tamer card placed under a Digimon become a digivolution card?
      Yes, it becomes a digivolution card.
      If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.

    • Q7425

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Does a Digimon gain the security effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
      No, it doesn't.

    • Q7426

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Does a Digimon gain the inherited effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
      Yes, it does.

      No.
      The Digimon given and by this effect must attack if possible.

    • Q7420

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What kind of card does "a card with X in its text" refer to?
      It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
      For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

    • Q7421

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Does the digivolution requirement that this card digivolve from a Tamer mean the Tamer that becomes a digivolution card is treated as if it is a Digimon when digivolving?
      No. Digivolve from the Tamer as such, and do not treat it as if it is a digivolving Digimon. "When a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger.
      Additionally, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect has activated, you can still digivolve from a Tamer with this digivolve requirement.

    • Q7422

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Do I perform a digivolution bonus draw even if I digivolve from a Tamer?
      Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw.
      A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

    • Q7423

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack this turn?
      No, it can't.
      A card can't attack on the turn it is played, even if it digivolves from a card placed on the field. It can only attack if it was not played that turn.

    • Q7424

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Does a Tamer card placed under a Digimon become a digivolution card?
      Yes, it becomes a digivolution card.
      If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.

    • Q7425

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Does a Digimon gain the security effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
      No, it doesn't.

    • Q7426

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Does a Digimon gain the inherited effects in the lower text of a Tamer card in its digivolution cards?
      Yes, it does.

    • Q7450

      The card is placed on the bottom of the cards under the Tamer.

    • Q7443

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can I change the stacking order of face-down cards under a Tamer?
      No, you can't.

    • Q7444

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can I search/look at face-down cards under a Tamer?
      Only the player of those cards can search/look at them.
      The opponent player can't search/look at them.

    • Q7445

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What happens if a face-down card under a Tamer is trashed?
      It's placed face-up in the trash.

    • Q7446

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can I trash only 2 specified cards or place only 1 of the specified cards as a digivolution card for the conditions of this card's [Main] effect?
      No, you can't.
      All of the conditions within "by doing X" must be fulfilled.
      The conditions for this [Main] effect require you to trash 3 specified cards and place 1 each of the specified cards as digivolution cards.

    • Q7447

      Sep. 18, 2026

      My Tamer currently has three or more face-down cards under it, and my trash is empty. Can I activate this card's [Main] effect?
      No.
      You can't activate this card's [Main] effect unless you have three or more face-down cards under one of your Tamers and one of each specified card in your trash.
      However, if you have all of those cards, you may activate this card's [Main] effect and place the cards trashed from under your Tamer under your [Kudamon].

    • Q7448

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If a Digimon such as [BT5-021 Syakomon] with a "players can't reduce play costs" effect is in the battle area, can I activate this card's [Main] effect and digivolve 1 of my Digimon into a specified card?
      You can activate the effect and digivolve, but its cost won't be reduced.

    • Q7450

    Card Q&A

    • Q7453

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What kind of card does "a card with X in its text" refer to?
      It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolve requirements, DNA Digivolve, DigiXros requirements, Burst Digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements.
      For example, "a card with [Knightmon] in its text" would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.

    • Q7454

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If I use this card's [All Turns] effect to place a card under a Tamer with cards under it, in what order do I place the card?
      The card is placed on the bottom of the cards under the Tamer.

    • Q7455

      Sep. 18, 2026

      A Digimon with [Knightmon] in its text is deleted, and that Digimon's [On Deletion] effect and this card's [All Turns] effect trigger simultaneously.
      At such a time, in what order does this card's [All Turns] effect and the deleted card's [On Deletion] effect activate?
      The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
      However, if this card's [All Turns] effect is activated first and the deleted card is then placed under this card, the card pending activation has left the area, so its [On Deletion] effect can't activate.

    Card Q&A

    • Q7457

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What does "may battle" mean, exactly?
      This effect immediately initiates a battle.
      If this effect is activated, the chosen Digimon battle according to the standard rules.

    • Q7458

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If 2 Digimon including a Digimon that has an "effects don't affect" effect are chosen for a "may battle" effect, can those Digimon battle?
      Yes, they can battle.
      A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect can still be chosen for an effect. In addition, a battle itself is a rule that compares DP, not an effect. Therefore, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen, and then it can battle.
      If it loses the battle, it will be deleted as normal according to the rules.

    • Q7459

      Sep. 18, 2026

      During an attack by my Digimon with , I activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect and the attacking Digimon battles one of my opponent's Digimon, deleting it in battle.
      Then, if my attacking Digimon's attack target successfully becomes one of my opponent's Digimon and it is also deleted in battle, can I use my Digimon's effect to perform two checks?
      No, you only perform one security check for .
      Only one security check can be performed during a single attack, even if activates multiple times.
      However, if the number of cards checked is modified by , that modified number of cards will be checked during a single security check.

    • Q7460

      Sep. 18, 2026

      During an attack by my Digimon with , I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to have that Digimon battle one of my opponent's Digimon and delete it.
      Then, if my attacking Digimon's attack target successfully becomes one of my opponent's Digimon, and that Digimon loses the battle but an effect prevents it from being deleted, can I still activate my Digimon's effect?
      Yes, you can.
      The effect triggers and activates if the Digimon deletes one of the opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, and it is resolved immediately before the end of attack timing.
      will still trigger even if another battle occurred during the attack in which the Digimon with successfully attacked and battled a Digimon.

    • Q7461

      Sep. 18, 2026

      When does "when this Digimon wins a battle" trigger?
      It triggers when the battle is won.
      When the Digimon with this effect wins a battle, the opponent's Digimon that lost the battle is deleted, then the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect can be activated.

    • Q7462

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Does a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect also trigger when a battle against a Security Digimon is won?
      Yes, it triggers.

    • Q7463

      Sep. 18, 2026

      A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon that lost the battle is deleted.
      At such times, in what order can players activate the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect and the effects that trigger upon the losing Digimon being deleted?
      They trigger simultaneously, so the turn player can activate their effects first.

      A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon lost the battle.
      At such times, in what order can players activate the winning Digimon's "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect and the losing Digimon's effects such as "when this Digimon would be deleted" and "when this Digimon would leave the battle area" effects?
      The "when this Digimon would be deleted" and "when this Digimon would leave the battle area" effects can be activated first.

      Sep. 18, 2026

      A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon lost the battle.

      Yes, it can be activated.

      A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon lost the battle.
      At such times, in what order can players activate the winning Digimon's "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect and the losing Digimon's effects such as "when this Digimon would be deleted" and "when this Digimon would leave the battle area" effects?
      The "when this Digimon would be deleted" and "when this Digimon would leave the battle area" effects can be activated first.

    • Q7465

      Sep. 18, 2026

      A Digimon with a "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect won a battle, and the opponent's Digimon lost the battle.
      At such times, can the "when this Digimon wins a battle" effect be activated even if an effect prevents the opponent's Digimon from being deleted?
      Yes, it can be activated.

    • Q7466

      Sep. 18, 2026

      For this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect, can I choose not to battle the opponent's Digimon after returning its digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck?
      No.
      You must battle the Digimon whose digivolution cards you returned to the deck with this effect if it's possible.

    • Q7467

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect return the digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck and battle a different Digimon from the Digimon it suspends?
      Yes.

    Card Q&A

    • Q7468

      Sep. 18, 2026

      What does "may battle" mean, exactly?
      This effect immediately initiates a battle.
      If this effect is activated, the chosen Digimon battle according to the standard rules.

    • Q7469

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If 2 Digimon including a Digimon that has an "effects don't affect" effect are chosen for a "may battle" effect, can those Digimon battle?
      Yes, they can battle.
      A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect can still be chosen for an effect. In addition, a battle itself is a rule that compares DP, not an effect. Therefore, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen, and then it can battle.
      If it loses the battle, it will be deleted as normal according to the rules.

    • Q7470

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can I choose a Digi-Egg card for the card returned to the deck with this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?
      Yes.
      However, if you choose a Digi-Egg card, it is returned to the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck instead.

    • Q7471

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can I only return 4 cards from my opponent's trash to their deck to meet the conditions of this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?
      No, you can't.
      All of the conditions within "by doing X" must be fulfilled.
      The conditions for this [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect require you to return 5 cards from the opponent's trash to the bottom of their deck.

    • Q7472

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If an effect that activates another effect one time "for every XX" can activate multiple types of effects multiple times, can I activate the same effect multiple times and/or activate different effects?
      Yes, you can.

    • Q7473

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If an effect that activates another effect one time "for every XX" can activate multiple types of effects multiple times, how is the effect activation order determined?
      An effect to activate is chosen, then the next effect to activate is chosen after the previous effect has been resolved.
      This is repeated one time for every XX.

    • Q7474

      Sep. 18, 2026

      If the number of XX changes during activation of effects by an effect that activates another effect one time "for every XX," does the number of activations also change?
      No, it doesn't.
      The number of XX is referenced at the point in time the effect that activates another effect one time "for every XX" is activated.

    • Q7475

      Sep. 18, 2026

      Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect reference this card's own color as well?
      Yes, it can.
      Additionally, it can also reference the color gained by this card's [All Turns] effect.

    • Q7476

      Sep. 18, 2026

      My Digimon and Tamers' colors currently total four.
      I activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect and choose the first effect to have it battle an opponent's Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect, and that Digimon gets deleted.
      If I then choose the second effect and return that deleted card to the bottom of the deck, will it prevent that returned card's [On Deletion] effect from activating?
      Yes, it will prevent it from activating.
      If a card with an effect pending activation leaves the area before the effect is activated, then the effect can't be activated.

    • Q7477

      Sep. 18, 2026

      When I activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect and choose its first effect to have it battle one of my opponent's Digimon, my opponent plays a new Digimon with one of their Digimon's immediate-type effects.
      After that happens, can I use the chosen first effect to battle the opponent's newly played Digimon?
      Yes, you can.

    • Q7478

      Sep. 18, 2026

      I have this card, 1 "red and blue Digimon," and 1 "red and yellow Tamer" in the battle area.
      If I activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect, how many times can I activate "activate 1 effect below"?
      Two times.
      In this situation, your Digimon and Tamers' colors are red, blue, yellow, and white, so you can activate it twice.
